group.name: Fromager bootstrap fails to resolve pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 dependency of langchain-milvus. On x86_64 candidates are rejected by release-age cooldown; on aarch64 no match found at all. group.error_description:
Fromager bootstrap fails to resolve pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 dependency of langchain-milvus. On x86_64 candidates are rejected by release-age cooldown; on aarch64 no match found at all. Two additional jobs (s390x, ppc64le) in the same rhai-cpu-ubi9 collection had their logs truncated at the 4MB limit before the error was captured, but were at similar bootstrap progress and likely hit the same failure.

Error messages:
- Unable to resolve requirement specifier pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 with constraint None using PyPI resolver (searching at https://pypi.org/simple): found 2 candidate(s) for pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 but all were published within the last 3 days (release-age cooldown; oldest is 2 day(s) old)
- Unable to resolve requirement specifier pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 with constraint None using PyPI resolver (searching at https://pypi.org/simple): found no match for pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 using PyPI resolver (searching at https://pypi.org/simple), searching for sdists, ignoring pre-release versions
- Job log exceeded 4MB limit and was truncated before error could be captured (rhai-cpu-ubi9 s390x and ppc64le jobs at ~85% bootstrap progress)
